STATUS: fail SUMMARY: Two reproduced blocking failures in Dialog: focus is lost on close when a child uses autoFocus, and Tab escapes the trap once the focused element inside the dialog is removed. Tabs and Combobox held up under 29 probes; the remaining findings are minor. FILES TOUCHED: none (probe file src/zz_redteam_probe.test.tsx created and deleted; git status matches the starting state) FINDINGS: - [blocking] Dialog restores focus to the wrong element when a child uses autoFocus. The Dialog layout effect captures `document.activeElement` after the child's autoFocus has already moved focus into the dialog. On close, focus lands on `body` instead of the Open button. Reproduced: ``, click Open, Escape, then `expect(getByText("Open")).toHaveFocus()` fails with `Received element with focus: `. Fix: capture `previous` before children commit, for example in render or a ref set before the dialog mounts. - [blocking] Focus trap leaks after the focused element is removed. The keydown handler is on the dialog, so when focus falls to `body` (the focused button was removed) Tab is not intercepted and focus moves to the page behind the modal. Reproduced: remove the focused "Remove me" button in an open dialog, then `user.tab()`. `document.activeElement` is ``, outside the dialog. Fix: handle Tab at the document level while the dialog is open, or move focus into the dialog when focus is outside it. - [minor] Dialog with `autoFocus` on a non-first focusable: the layout effect focuses the first focusable, overriding the autoFocus child (received `Cancel`, not the input). Matches the spec's "first focusable" wording but breaks React's autoFocus intent. Reproduced. - [minor] `description=""` still sets `aria-describedby` on the dialog, which points to an empty `

`. Spec says "only when a description is given". Reproduced. - [minor] Tabs: when the selected tab is disabled in uncontrolled mode, `aria-selected` stays true on the disabled tab. Not reproduced as a criterion failure; observed in code reading only. - [minor] Combobox: Enter with no active option does not preventDefault, so inside a form it submits. README says it "does nothing". Code-read only, not reproduced. - [minor] Combobox: `activeValue` is not cleared when the active option is removed by an options change, so it reactivates if that option returns. Code-read only, not reproduced. - [minor] Tabs: arrow keys with one enabled tab call `onValueChange` for the already-selected tab. Code-read only, not reproduced.
